changelog:
## MetaBoost v3.0.0

### Major Change: Migrasi total pada UI
- Tampilan lebih modern, responsif, dan premium

### Model AI Baru
- Gemini 3.x model support (Gemini 3.5, Gemini 3.1, Gemma 4)
- New OpenRouter models: gemini-3.1-flash-lite, gpt-5.5, gpt-5.5-pro
- Default model diubah ke gemini-3.1-flash-lite

### Improvements
- Improvement pada fitur-fitur tertentu

### Bug Fixes
- Hapus deprecated Groq models (llama-4-maverick, kimi-k2-instruct)
- Hapus deprecated Gemini 2.0 variants di OpenRouter
